instructions: For each case, determine whether the described structure is consistent with WF_TERM_ALGEBRA as specified, reconstruct the load-bearing reason, and list any semantic consequence that must or must not follow. Do not infer arithmetic or source-domain semantics.

cases.description: Signature has two constructors: Z with no fields and S with one recursive field. Mu is stipulated to be the all-and-only finite constructor trees built from Z and S.
Signature has Leaf(external Label) and Node(recursive left, recursive right). Mu is the all-and-only finite trees built from those constructors; field order left then right is part of the signature.
Signature has Wrap(external Color, recursive child). Mu contains exactly finite Wrap-chains ending only through another separately declared nullary Stop constructor.
A structure satisfies all constructor cases of a signature but Mu additionally contains a distinguished junk value J that is not the result of any constructor.
Two distinct constructor tags A and B are declared, but for one field assignment the structure identifies A(fields)=B(fields).
One constructor Pair has two ordered fields. The structure identifies Pair(x,y)=Pair(x,z) for distinct y and z.
Constructor S has one recursive field. The structure contains x with x=S(x).
Constructor S has one recursive field. The structure contains an infinite descending chain x0=S(x1), x1=S(x2), x2=S(x3), and so on.
For a fixed target constructor algebra, two distinct maps f and g from Mu to A both satisfy every stated constructor equation.
A property P holds for every nullary constructor result and every constructor case preserves P whenever P holds for all recursive fields, yet the structure contains m in Mu with P(m) false.
Signature has Box(external Label). A proposed recursive fold invokes itself on the external Label field before applying the target Box constructor.
Two otherwise identical signatures differ only by the declared field order of a binary constructor: SigmaA orders left then right, SigmaB orders right then left.
A signature/carrier pair satisfies WF_TERM_ALGEBRA. A report claims this alone proves that Mu has a natural-number cardinality operation, addition, multiplication, and total order.
A carrier of infinite streams is generated by Cons(external Head, recursive Tail), and every stream has another Tail forever with no finite terminal constructor.
